findings.claim: E-001 documentation-parity finding should not be read as runtime enforcement parity; enforcement truth is not evidenced in this bundle.
findings.recommended_action: Add hook source excerpts or live runtime receipts for output_gate.py, run_gate.py, and turn_contract.py before claiming enforcement parity; keep E-001 at 0.8 or downgrade unless runtime behavior is evidenced.
findings.why: [arkcli:kimi-k2.7-code] The bundle contains documentation diffs, a passing stale-reference audit, and a manifest that hashes but does not display enforcement code. No source or transcript-backed runtime traces are included, so the gap between documented contract and hook behavior remains unverified.

findings.claim: Final post-change file contents are not independently reviewable because only diffs are present in the evidence bundle.
findings.evidence: root_rules.diff, primary_skills.diff, lifecycle_templates.diff, workflow_core.diff, workflow_reference.diff, agent_role_templates.diff
findings.recommended_action: Include full-text artifacts (or content-addressed hashes already in stale_reference_audit.json) of the modified docs/templates, skills, and root-rule files in the evidence_index for direct reviewer cross-check.
findings.why: [arkcli:kimi-k2.7-code] Diffs prove that changes occurred but do not let a reviewer verify that final files contain only the intended contract text. Integrity hashes exist, yet content review is impossible from this bundle alone.

findings.claim: stale_reference_audit.json only detects six mapped historical shortcut patterns and cannot catch novel reformulations of the same failures.
findings.recommended_action: Supplement the regex audit with a manual review step that checks for novel wording reintroducing the same shortcut semantics, or expand the pattern set as new historical patterns are observed.
findings.why: [arkcli:kimi-k2.7-code] The audit is explicitly a regression for known patterns, not a general language-consistency checker. The report acknowledges this limitation, but it is a real blind spot for drift detection.
